comment: E2E (CHANGELOG 2026-09 section 143): an http_request destination that comes from data dials only public addresses, unless the author lists its host in allowed_hosts. trigger_webhook's test_payload stands in for data that names three destinations; each reaches an http_request through an edge that names base_url. Serve 127.0.0.1:8765 first (python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1). Expected: to_public (a public host) answers; to_listed (127.0.0.1:8765, in allowed_hosts) answers; to_link_local (not listed) fails before any connection with 'a destination that comes from data connects only to a public address'. The status edges order the calls: each call waits for the previous one's status, which also reaches its request as an `after` query parameter (the servers ignore it).
